source_artifacts.description: Repo path/URL, app build, screenshots, issue list, and (QA mode) the diff/PR/build to verify.

known_context.description: PROJECT_CANON.md excerpt or prior PRODUCT_AUDIT.md summary, if available.

mode.description: AUDIT: inspect and produce a plan, never implement. QA: verify delivered work against a prior plan, never fix.

prior_run.description: Path to prior IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md / REGRESSION_MATRIX.md / PRODUCT_AUDIT.md. Required when mode is QA.
